variation: High-bar back squat, approximately shoulder-width stance
camera: Fixed three-quarter view facing left; entire body, both bar ends and shoes visible on one portrait canvas.
anchors: Both heels and toes, ground plane, camera and crop remain fixed; head/torso/pelvis move only as required by the squat.
equipment: Rigid straight bar on upper traps, one identical modest plate on each end, equal sleeves and collars. Both hands keep fixed grip width. No rack changes or plate labels.
stabilisers: Pale purple at trunk/spinal stabilisers only, no unrelated upper-arm highlighting.
